manifest.name: OpenAI Codex - Rust Navigation
manifest.description: Optimized for navigating the OpenAI Codex agent codebase by analyzing 2122 Rust files. Tracks agent_navigation_role, runtime_paths, and task_intents to help AI agents identify entry points, dispatchers, and protocol handlers within the Codex architecture.

analyzers.name: rust-agent-navigation::file-content::default
analyzers.description: Generates Rust-only coding-agent navigation metadata so future agents can retrieve a small, high-confidence reading list for feature work, model-call tracing, tool-call analysis, history export, context injection, and related tasks.

analyzers.name: code-intent::file-content::default
analyzers.description: Generates a discovery-optimized summary and metadata, including Action-Object keywords, functional parent domains, interface types, and logic constraints.

fields.name: language
fields.description: `rust` for `.rs` files, otherwise `non-rust`.

fields.name: crate_name
fields.description: Inferred Rust crate name from the path or visible crate metadata, or null.

fields.name: module_kind
fields.description: One of `lib`, `bin`, `module`, `test`, `fixture`, `build-script`, `generated`, or `unknown`.

fields.name: product_areas
fields.description: 1-3 product areas from the allowed list.

fields.name: surface_types
fields.description: 0-6 visible user, API, model, history, tool, extension, or test surfaces.

fields.name: runtime_paths
fields.description: 0-6 visible runtime paths.

fields.name: agent_navigation_role
fields.description: One primary role such as `entry-point`, `dispatcher`, `state-owner`, `protocol-type`, `formatter`, `transport`, `persistence`, `adapter`, `extension-point`, `test`, `fixture`, `helper`, `generated`, or `unknown`.

fields.name: agent_task_intents
fields.description: 1-8 task-intent tags that should retrieve this file.

fields.name: navigation_summary
fields.description: One concise sentence explaining why a future coding agent should retrieve this file.

fields.name: referenced_domain_objects
fields.description: Important visible types, traits, functions, enum variants, modules, strings, config keys, RPC methods, slash commands, or protocol items.

fields.name: visible_entrypoints
fields.description: Public functions, methods, enum variants, handlers, tests, or symbols worth jumping to first.

fields.name: visible_outputs
fields.description: Events, requests, responses, persisted items, UI output, files, or side effects visibly produced.

fields.name: visibility
fields.description: 1-6 values from `user-visible`, `model-visible`, `persisted`, `hidden-context`, `telemetry`, `debug-only`, `experimental`, `internal`, `test-only`, or `unknown`.

fields.name: publicness
fields.description: One of `public`, `internal`, `debug-only`, `experimental`, `test-only`, or `unknown`.

fields.name: open_when
fields.description: 1-5 concrete task conditions where an agent should open this file.

fields.name: skip_when
fields.description: 1-5 concrete false-positive conditions where an agent should avoid this file.

fields.name: test_expectations
fields.description: Likely validation obligations visible from the file, or null.

fields.name: change_risk
fields.description: One of `low`, `medium`, `high`, or `unknown`.

fields.name: change_risk_reason
fields.description: One sentence explaining change risk using visible evidence.

fields.name: confidence
fields.description: One of `high`, `medium`, or `low`.

fields.name: confidence_reason
fields.description: One sentence explaining confidence in the navigation metadata.

fields.name: file_path
fields.description: No description available.

fields.name: file_name
fields.description: No description available.

fields.name: file_extension
fields.description: No description available.

fields.name: chat_id
fields.description: No description available.

fields.name: purpose
fields.description: A change-centric summary starting with "Modify this file to change..." or "Use this file to change...".

fields.name: type
fields.description: The standardized category of the file (e.g., `source_code`, `documentation`, `blog_post`). Must be a value defined in `keyword-map.json` or a standard default.

fields.name: dates
fields.description: An array of date strings formatted as `yyyy-mm-dd_type` (e.g., `["2023-10-27_published", "2023-11-05_modified"]`). Null if no dates.

fields.name: keywords
fields.description: An array of 3-7 specific, high-discrimination keywords. MUST be "Action-Object" pairs. MUST exclude stop words. Quality over quantity.

fields.name: parent_keywords
fields.description: An array of 2-5 broader, functional domain keywords that group the specific keywords.

fields.name: key_entities
fields.description: A list of the most important named components within the file.

fields.name: mechanism
fields.description: The interface/pattern type (e.g., `cli-command`, `rest-api`, `webhook-handler`, `factory-pattern`). Null if not applicable.

fields.name: logic_constraints
fields.description: A list of hardcoded business logic or configuration constants found in the file. Null if none found.
